entries.zh: 金精：金（五行之金）的精气；亦指民间信奉的精怪精灵，西注谓“为人所杀之神灵”
entries.en: essence-spirit of metal/gold; a duende (sprite) whom they kill

entries.zh: 蛇虫：蛇类与虫豸（蛇及昆虫、蠕虫之类）
entries.en: snakes and vermin (serpents and crawling insects)
entries.notes: 西语栏“duende a quien adrano nos mulebra”疑有讹读、与“蛇虫”义不合，释义以汉字栏与音写栏为准

entries.zh: 嫂仔：嫂，兄之妻；亦指家中掌侍役的妇人称呼（西注：侍役之女主人）
entries.en: mistress in charge of the household service; also an address for a woman, elder brother's wife

entries.zh: 饧：饴糖、麦芽糖浆（糖稀）；味甜
entries.en: sweet thing; syrup of malt sugar

entries.zh: 公：公爵（西注谓世袭所得之爵位）；又指公共、祖父、公公
entries.en: duke (noble rank held by inheritance); also public, grandfather

entries.zh: 万代公侯：公爵侯爵之位世代相承，传之万世
entries.en: dukes and marquises for ten thousand generations — nobility inherited forever

entries.zh: 倘：“倘”常义为假如、倘若；此处西注作“延续一段时间”（耐久），与字义不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to last (for a while), to endure
entries.notes: 汉字栏“倘”常义为“假如”，与西语词头 durar（耐久）不合，且第 9、10 两条共用同一西注，疑西语栏有串行

entries.zh: 容：容纳、宽容，又指容貌；此处西注作“延续一段时间”，与字义不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to contain, to tolerate; appearance; (per the Spanish head) to last, to endure
entries.notes: 汉字栏“容”常义（容纳/容貌）与西语词头 durar 不合，疑西语栏串行所致

entries.zh: 坚固：坚固、结实，极耐久（西注：如经重锤锤打而成）
entries.en: solid and firm, very durable ('made as with a heavy hammer')

entries.zh: 目前光：眼前之光，喻转瞬即逝、不能持久（西注：不能久存）
entries.en: 'light before the eyes' — what lasts only a moment, short-lived

entries.zh: 金使：字面为“金”＋“使”（金之使者/使之成金），确义无法定夺；西注“延续并支撑之”与字义不合，释义存疑
entries.en: uncertain: Chinese head '金使' (gold + envoy/make) cannot be reconciled with the Spanish head 'to last and sustain it'; gloss doubtful
entries.notes: 四栏无法互证：汉字栏“金使”与西注 durar y sostener 无从对合，音写栏 sày 与对音栏 sĭn 亦不一致，故降为低置信

entries.zh: 杏：杏子（杏树之果）；可入药（杏仁），西注谓其形似桃
entries.en: apricot (fruit like the peach, used in medicine)

entries.zh: 仙桃：天上仙桃，食之长生（仙界之桃）
entries.en: peach of heaven, the peach of immortality (Spanish note partly garbled: he who eats it … cannot have both)
entries.notes: 西语栏后半讹读难解（“el gall una Dieng no puede tener ambos”），但“桃 del cielo＝仙桃”义明确
